summary.en: Create array objects, follow row lengths and use safe indexing and Arrays utilities.
summary.bn: অ্যারে অবজেক্ট বানান, প্রতিটি সারির দৈর্ঘ্য বুঝুন আর নিরাপদে উপাদান ব্যবহার করুন।

notes: The array features and Arrays utilities used here are available in Java 17 and earlier releases.

sections.title: Create an array and name its bounds
Draw the outer array and its rows
Observe defaults, sorting and safe access
Respect both length and reference state
No newer array syntax is needed
Track the object behind each array reference

examples.title: Length and default values
examples.explanationHtml: The new array contains three int elements. Each starts as zero.

examples.title: Sorting a mark list
examples.explanationHtml: Sorting changes marks itself. The readable display is [40, 70, 90].

examples.title: Rows with different lengths
examples.explanationHtml: A two-dimensional array holds row references. These rows contain two, one and zero elements.

examples.title: Check an index before reading
examples.explanationHtml: An index equal to length lies outside the array. The guard prints Invalid index without attempting that access.

practice.title: Sum a mark array
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 50 followed by n marks from 0 to 100. Store them and print their total.
hints: An empty array has a total of zero.

practice.title: Safe lookup
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 10, then n integers, then an index. Print the selected value or Invalid index.

practice.title: Sort attendance counts
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 50, then n counts from 0 to 30. Print the ascending array using Arrays.toString.

practice.title: Jagged row totals
practice.statementHtml: Input: row count r from 0 to 5; for each row, its length from 0 to 5 and its integer values from 0 to 100. Print each row sum on its own line, or Empty when r is zero.
hints: Allocate each row before reading its elements.

quiz.prompt: Which value occupies a newly allocated int element?
quiz.explanation: Every element of a new int array starts at zero.

quiz.prompt: Which length belongs to the second jagged row?
quiz.explanation: a[1] refers to the row containing only 4, so its length is 1.

quiz.prompt: What order remains after Arrays.sort changes this array?
quiz.explanation: sort puts the original int array in ascending numeric order.

quiz.prompt: Which expression gives an array length?
quiz.explanation: Array length is a field, unlike the String length() method.

quiz.prompt: What happens when you access a[3] for an array of length 3?
quiz.explanation: Indices 0, 1 and 2 are valid. Java checks every array access.
Zero length is legal. Such an array has no valid element index.

quiz.prompt: What is stored in new int[2][] before row allocation?
quiz.explanation: The outer array holds reference elements, whose initial value is null.

quiz.prompt: How can you change the length of an existing array object?
options: Create a different array and copy needed values
quiz.explanation: An existing array length is fixed. A variable can later refer to another array.

quiz.prompt: Which utility displays an int array as readable element text?
quiz.explanation: Arrays.toString formats contents. Printing an array reference directly does not list its elements.

quiz.prompt: Why use values[row].length in a jagged traversal?
options: The outer length always equals zero
Each row can contain a different number of elements
quiz.explanation: A row-specific bound prevents stepping past a shorter row.

quiz.prompt: What does cloning an int[] copy?
options: Only a reference to the same array
Its primitive element values into another array
A new array with all elements zero
quiz.explanation: An int array clone has independent element storage with copied values.

quiz.prompt: Which statement distinguishes an empty row from a null row?
options: Only null is a valid reference value
An empty row has length zero; null has no row object
quiz.explanation: Reading length is valid on an empty array and invalid through null.

keyPoints.en: An array has a fixed length after creation.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যারে বানানোর পরে তার দৈর্ঘ্য বদলায় না।

keyPoints.en: Valid indices run from zero to length minus one.
keyPoints.bn: সঠিক ইনডেক্স শূন্য থেকে length-এর এক কম পর্যন্ত।

keyPoints.en: Each row of a two-dimensional array can have its own length.
keyPoints.bn: দুই মাত্রার অ্যারের প্রতিটি সারির দৈর্ঘ্য আলাদা হতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: Arrays.toString shows element values in a readable form.
keyPoints.bn: Arrays.toString দিয়ে অ্যারের মানগুলো পড়ার মতো করে দেখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Arrays.sort changes the order of the original array.
keyPoints.bn: Arrays.sort মূল অ্যারের উপাদানের ক্রম বদলায়।

examQuestions.question: Explain the memory shape of int[][] values = new int[3][].
examQuestions.answerHtml: The outer array contains three references, initially null. Each reference can later point to an int array of its own length. No inner int arrays exist yet.

examQuestions.question: Outline a safe row-by-row sum for a jagged int array.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Visit each allocated row. Start its sum at zero and add each element up to that row length. Print the sum even for an empty row. Decide how null rows should be handled if the design allows them.

examQuestions.question: What changes after int[] b = a; Arrays.sort(b)?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Both variables refer to the same array, so sorting through b changes the element order observed through a. Reference assignment does not copy elements.
